research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SkySafe is engaged in developing systems and methods for detecting, monitoring, and mitigating the presence of drones, as described in titles such as 'Systems and methods for detecting, monitoring, and mitigating the presence of a drone.' Their work includes using radio-frequency receivers to identify RF signals between drones and controllers, and methods for detecting scrambling seeds in drone communications. These areas reflect a focus on real-time drone detection, monitoring, and airspace management.

press_references.value: SkySafe Unveils Forensics as a Service, Completing the Industry’s First End-to-End Drone Detection and Airspace Intelligence Platform

product_launches.description: SkySafe launched Forensics as a Service (FaaS), adding investigative forensics to its drone detection and airspace intelligence platform to help agencies extract, analyze, and operationalize drone data with legally admissible reports, training, and CFID hardware.

overview_description.description:
SkySafe's technology allows governments, law enforcement, airports, corporations, cities, and more to manage their airspace with real-time drone data and analytics.

SkySafe was founded in 2015 in San Diego, CA. The SkySafe team consists of drone and signals experts from MIT, UC San Diego, the Air Force Research Lab, and more. Our goal is to build safe, secure airspaces as a new wild west of drone development and innovation emerges.

product.name: SkySafe Drone Detection & Airspace Intelligence Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that detects, tracks, and analyzes drone activity in real time, helping security teams monitor airspace, assess threats, receive alerts, and coordinate responses.

product.name: SkySafe Drone Forensics
product.description: A drone forensics platform and service that extracts flight data, identifies operators, reconstructs incidents, and produces exportable evidence reports for investigations and legal proceedings.

product.name: Drone Forensics Training
product.description: Training for personnel who need practical skills in drone recovery, data extraction, and incident analysis, delivered in person or online with scenario-based exercises.
